title: Refund-Wait Credit on Error Returns - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Training note - error-return refunds, Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

An error-return refund carries a refund-wait credit that counts calendar days from the received date on the return authorization being settled (the latest on the order in status received, by received date) to today.

| Calendar days since the item was received | Refund-wait credit |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | $2.00 |
| 4 or more, but fewer than 7 | $1.00 |
| Fewer than 4 | Nothing |

### Questions answered

**Which date starts the count?** The received date on the authorization - the date the item reached a store or the returns center - not the date the return was authorized.

**Is the threshold day included in the higher band?** Yes. Day 4 earns $1.00 and day 7 earns $2.00; day 3 earns nothing and day 6 earns $1.00.

**Example (hypothetical).** An item received on 2 June is being refunded on 10 June: 8 calendar days, a $2.00 credit. Refunded on 5 June: 3 days, no credit.
